project_identity.vibe: Premium Educational Publishing House, University Press meets Modern Digital Bookstore
project_identity.theme: Light theme by default (warm, paper-like) with Dark Mode support (Oxford blue, deep).
project_identity.relationship_to_factory: Factory is the private manufacturing admin (Royal/Gold, strict). QRU Online is the public presentation layer (Warmer, softer, highly curated, discovery-focused, sharing the Treasure Standard trust signal).

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large display numbers, brand promises

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x normal). Use p-12, p-16, p-24 to create an 'art gallery' or 'premium bookstore' feel.
spacing_and_layout.home_page: Editorial Bento layout. Large hero text, asymmetric grid for featured books (e.g. col-span-8 for main, col-span-4 for secondary).
spacing_and_layout.catalog_page: High density yet breathable. Grid cols-1 md:cols-2 lg:cols-3 or 4. Book covers must dominate the card space with a 2:3 or 3:4 aspect ratio.
spacing_and_layout.book_page: Split view: Sticky left column with large book cover, right column scrolling with rich details, 'What You'll Learn', and read/preview affordance.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphic 'Tactile' variants for books. Use 1px delicate borders (border-[#E5E5E0]) with soft ambient drop-shadows (shadow-xl shadow-black/5) on covers to make them look like physical books.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky top navigation (bg-[#FAFAF8]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E5E0]/50) to maintain content visibility while scrolling. Never completely transparent.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper noise/grain overlay on the body background to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Concentric, layered shadows for book covers. No harsh dark shadows. Use warm-tinted shadows.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-[#1C1C1A] text-[#FAFAF8] hover:bg-[#C5A059] transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-[#FAFAF8].
components.cards: Cardless or minimal cards. Let the book cover be the hero. Text sits cleanly below or beside the cover with ample padding.
components.navigation: Minimalist header. Left: QRU Online Logo (Serif). Right: Links (Catalog, University, Press) + Search icon. Must be sticky with blur.
components.footer: Massive padding (py-24). Contains 'The Treasure Standard™' trust signal prominently. Dark bg (#0A1128) with Gold text for contrast against light theme pages.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Book covers translate slightly up (-translate-y-2) with increased shadow (shadow-2xl) and a subtle sheen effect.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight vertical slide (framer-motion).
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for premium smooth scrolling.

hero_background.description: Elegant warm bookshelf, use for the Home Hero overlay (bg-black/30 or mask-image fade).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over any gold accent meets 4.5:1 ratio (usually implies dark text on gold).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-preview-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color hex codes and font families provided.
Use standard Tailwind classes mapped to these variables.
Do NOT use HTML standard components for complex interactions; use Shadcn UI (but customize them heavily to remove the 'SaaS' look).
Install and use `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` for icons.
Ensure generous padding in layout containers (p-8 to p-24).
Implement the UI with a light mode default, utilizing the Warm Bone/Cream background to simulate a high-end publishing paper feel.
Follow JS implementation, as it is a JS project, not TSX.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts. Use grid asymmetry.
Always use modern pill-shaped or elegantly rounded buttons.
Include hover states and micro-animations on interactive elements.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Do NOT apply global `transition: all` as it breaks transforms.
Always add data-testid attributes to interactive and key informational elements.
